movie.title: V
movie.overview: In the early 1990s, this city of desire, once a land of opportunity, was plagued by rampant crime and a breakdown of order. Man Tsz-keung, a working-class man desperate to change his fate, meets flight attendant Lok Ka-yuen, and the two team up to rob a large sum of money. This success fuels Man Tsz-keung's madness, pushing him into a deeper power struggle with wealthy businessman Chan Fai-yin. Meanwhile, mainland police officer Qi Honggang and Hong Kong police officer Guan Suchen continue their investigation of Wan Ziqiang, leading to a joint operation between the two police forces, setting the stage for a clash between good and evil. This film is fictional.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Geng Jie's ambitious pursuit of success and stability in Xicheng turns into a perilous battle for survival after a chance encounter with a flight attendant pulls him into a dangerous underworld.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Driven by intense ambition, Geng Jie moves to Xicheng and rapidly builds success through bold and risky business enterprises. However, his life takes a dramatic turn when he meets a captivating flight attendant while attempting to settle down into a stable lifestyle. Caught in a web of crime and betrayal, he is drawn into a high-stakes vortex that threatens everything he has built. To survive, Geng Jie must navigate a ruthless underworld where every choice carries fatal consequences.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Determined to change his fortune, Geng Jie leaves his modest beginnings behind and ventures to the bustling metropolis of Xicheng. Through sheer determination, daring enterprise, and clever strategies, he rapidly overcomes initial obstacles to achieve impressive financial success. Despite his newfound wealth, Geng Jie feels a growing sense of emptiness and begins searching for a grounded, stable life. That quest leads him to cross paths with a flight attendant whose charm and independence immediately captivate him. As he attempts to win her affection and build a peaceful future, unforeseen complications arise from his past business dealings and dangerous associates. Caught off guard, Geng Jie finds himself entangled in a treacherous conflict involving criminal factions, corruption, and high-stakes rivalry. The escalating tension forces him into a desperate struggle for survival as he tries to shield his personal life from the surrounding chaos. Drawn deeper into a swirling vortex of deceit, Geng Jie must rely on his razor-sharp instincts to outsmart his enemies. Ultimately, his journey becomes a harrowing trial where every decision tests his resilience and moral boundaries.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set in the sprawling city of Xicheng, V follows Geng Jie, an ambitious young man whose bold entrepreneurial spirit fuels a rapid rise to prominence. Yet, behind his professional success lies a growing desire for peace and genuine connection. When Geng Jie meets a flight attendant, his pursuit of a stable, grounded life seems finally within reach. However, hidden dangers and volatile underworld ties soon emerge, threatening to tear his dream apart. Entangled in a high-stakes web of crime, ambition, and survival, Geng Jie is thrust into a dangerous vortex where he must navigate complex power struggles to protect the life he envisions.
